notes:
Saved chapters are really saved now.

Downloading a chapter used to fetch every page and tick it green — and then open it from the network anyway. With no signal you got nothing. The saved pages are now what the reader opens.

• Every site, not just MangaDex. Asura, Weeb Central, MangaPill and MangaKatana chapters can all be saved.
• Save next 1 / 5 / 10 / 20 from the Chapters header — the next ones you haven't read, not the oldest ones, one at a time so it doesn't hog your connection.
• A saved chapter shows a tick you can tap to remove it, and one that failed shows a retry instead of pretending it worked.
• A half-finished download never opens as a chapter with pages missing.

Pair it with v2.46's kept narration and a saved chapter reads and reads aloud with no connection at all.
